title: No Mist Output
shortDescription: Unit runs but produces no mist.
fullDescription: E1 on Levoit ultrasonic humidifiers indicates no mist - typically low water, mineral-coated transducer, or dry-run protection.

fixSteps.title: Clean transducer
fixSteps.instruction: Apply white vinegar to the ceramic disc, let sit 10 minutes, wipe.

whenToCallPro: Rarely needed - typically a warranty replacement.
videoSearchQuery: Levoit humidifier E1 no mist clean

faq.a: Distilled is best - tap creates white dust.

title: Water Tank Empty
fullDescription: Indicator and auto shutoff triggered when tank runs dry.

title: Clean Reminder
fullDescription: C indicates the humidifier has tracked enough run time to require descaling. Clean the water tank and transducer.

faq.a: Diluted bleach is OK for deep clean but rinse thoroughly.

title: Sensor Error
fullDescription: E2 indicates humidity sensor failure. Auto mode disabled.

title: Target Humidity Reached
fullDescription: HI shows when target humidity is reached in auto mode. Unit pauses until RH drops.

title: VeSync Wi-Fi Disconnected
fullDescription: Wi-Fi icon goes off when VeSync app cannot reach the device. Reconnect via app.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Hold mist button 5 seconds, use VeSync app to add.

title: Filter Replacement
fullDescription: Models with evaporative absorption wicks show F when filter is saturated or due for replacement.

title: Water Leaking from Base
fullDescription: Leaks usually come from a cracked tank or worn gasket. Inspect tank seal.

fixSteps.title: Inspect gasket
fixSteps.instruction: Remove cap and check gasket for cracks.

title: Pink or Black Slime in Tank
fullDescription: Pink or black residue is biofilm. Clean with bleach solution monthly and always empty tank when not in use.

fixSteps.title: Bleach clean
fixSteps.instruction: 1 tsp bleach per gallon water, soak 30 minutes, rinse thoroughly.

title: Sleep Mode Display Off
shortDescription: Display turned off in sleep mode.
fullDescription: In sleep mode the display dims or turns off. Press any button to wake.

faq.a: Toggle mode button out of sleep.
